name: Erasca, Inc.
summary: Erasca, Inc., a clinical-stage precision oncology company, focuses on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. The company's product pipeline includes ERAS-0015, a pan-RAS molecular glue for the treatment of patients with RAS-mutated solid tumors; ERAS-4001, a pan-KRAS inhibitor for the treatment of patients with KRAS-mutated solid tumors; and ERAS-12, an investigational EGFR D2/D3 biparatopic antibody (bpAb) for the treatment of EGFR and RAS/MAPK solid tumors.
